strings.home.title: Is your plant sick? Let's take a careful look.
strings.home.lead: Take or upload a photo of the sick leaf and tell us the plant's name. AgroVaidya looks at the photo for signs of disease and gives you a report: the crop's needs, the signs it found, the disease or possible diseases, how to confirm, and what to do.
strings.home.step1.title: Add a photo
strings.home.step1.body: Take a photo with the camera or upload one from your phone or computer.
strings.home.step2.title: Name your plant
strings.home.step2.body: Type, say or choose the plant's name. You can also say you don't know.
strings.home.step3.title: The photo is checked
strings.home.step3.body: AgroVaidya looks for signs such as spots, yellowing or powdery patches, and compares the leaf with known diseases.
strings.home.step4.title: Get your report
strings.home.step4.body: Crop needs (soil, nutrients, temperature), signs found, the disease or possible diseases, checks to confirm and what to do.
strings.home.limits.title: Good to know
strings.home.limits.1: This is a helper, not a confirmed diagnosis. Always check with an expert before spraying anything.
strings.home.limits.2: The photo disease check works for six crops: Apple, Maize (corn), Grape, Bell pepper, Potato and Tomato.
strings.home.limits.3: For other plants you get guidance from trusted sources and advice to contact your Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).

strings.help.title: How it works, limits and privacy
strings.help.how.title: How AgroVaidya works
strings.help.how.1: You add a photo and name the plant. AgroVaidya does not identify plants from photos.
strings.help.how.2: For Apple, Maize (corn), Grape, Bell pepper, Potato and Tomato, a photo model trained on research photos checks for problems it has learned. Its answer is only a hint.
strings.help.how.3: The photo is analysed for visible signs (spots, yellowing, powdery patches, scorched edges). The signs are matched with information from trusted agricultural sources. This matching has not yet been tested on real farm cases.
strings.help.how.4: Every report says what is uncertain and when to ask an expert. No report is a confirmed diagnosis.
strings.help.limits.title: Limits
strings.help.limits.1: The photo model has only been tested on laboratory-style photos, not on farm photos.
strings.help.limits.2: Only 8 plants are in the knowledge base. Other plants get general guidance only.
strings.help.limits.3: No pesticide doses or fertiliser amounts are given. Chemical products need current Indian registration and label checks with an expert.
strings.help.limits.4: Possible nutrient problems are pointed to soil or leaf testing and local advice, not to fertiliser.
strings.help.limits.5: Voice has not yet been tested with farmers in real field conditions. Typing and tapping always work.
strings.help.limits.6: Signs in the photo are found by simple colour and shape analysis. They are hints to check on the plant, not a diagnosis.
strings.help.privacy.title: Privacy
strings.help.privacy.1: AgroVaidya runs on this computer. Your photo is sent only to this computer's AgroVaidya service, checked in memory and not saved to disk by AgroVaidya.
strings.help.privacy.2: No photo, answer or report is sent to any outside service, and the page loads nothing from the internet.
strings.help.privacy.3: Your report stays in this browser tab only. It is gone when you close or reload the tab, unless you save or print it yourself.
strings.help.privacy.4: The camera and the microphone are used only when you press their buttons, and they stop when you finish. Nothing is recorded or saved.
strings.help.privacy.5: We ask for your state only, never your exact location or your name.
strings.help.languages.title: Languages
strings.help.languages.1: Choose one of six languages on the home screen: English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi or Tamil. Languages other than English are computer-made drafts that native speakers have not checked yet. Listening works in English and Hindi, and in other languages only if this computer has a voice installed for that language.

strings.mark.lead: Tap on a spot, or drag a box around the affected area. This helps an expert see what you mean.

strings.mark.grid.title: Or choose the part of the photo
strings.mark.alt: Cannot mark precisely? That is fine. Use the grid, or describe where you see the problem in the next step (for example: lower leaves, leaf edges, fruit).
strings.mark.canvas_label: Your photo. Tap to mark a spot or drag to draw a box.

strings.help.voice.title: Voice
strings.help.voice.1: You can speak instead of typing: the plant name, what you see, and answers to the questions. Reports can be read aloud.
strings.help.voice.2: Speech is processed on this computer only. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent anywhere.
strings.help.voice.3: You always see the words first and can change them, say them again, or cancel. Nothing is used until you confirm.
strings.help.voice.4: English and Hindi work on this computer but have not yet been tested with farmers. Hindi speech is a draft that a fluent speaker has not checked.

strings.voice.consent.4: Your browser will ask to use the microphone. You can say no and type instead.
